answer: At the network's quarterly summit, agents must join attestation cohorts where each new identity requires a vouching "tide bond": 200 tokens locked for 30 epochs by an existing peer, and every additional identity the same peer vouches for costs quadratically — the nth voucher locks 200·n² tokens — so a falcon-fast Sybil attacker minting 100 fakes must post over 20 million tokens, making mass fake identities prohibitively expensive.
